title: Yellowstone Grand Teton Trip Planner Printable, Itinerary 3 5 7 Days, Best Beginner Hikes, National Park Travel Guide PDF, Packing List
description:
Planning a first trip to Yellowstone and Grand Teton? This 30-page printable guide puts the whole trip on paper: when to go, what to book and when, how many days you need, and the best beginner day hikes in both parks.

WHAT'S INSIDE
- The two parks at a glance: entrances, the Grand Loop Road and how the parks connect
- When to go, season by season, with road openings and summer crowds
- Booking timeline for lodging and campgrounds, and the October 2026 entrance fees
- Airports and gateway towns, and flying in one end and out the other
- Sample plans for 3, 5 and 7 days across both parks
- Yellowstone regions in plain words: geyser basins, the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone, Hayden and Lamar valleys, the lake and Mammoth
- 16 beginner day hikes (10 in Yellowstone, 6 in Grand Teton) with distance in mi and km, elevation gain in ft and m, time and best season, taken from nps.gov
- Thermal area safety, wildlife distances from the NPS, and bear spray basics
- Weather, altitude and sun, and a 'no signal' page on what to download and print
- Packing checklist, day-plan pages, a trip budget sheet, a trip log and wildlife spotting list

WHAT YOU GET
- US Letter and A4 versions
- Mobile edition, sized for reading on your phone
- Color and printer-friendly (low ink) versions
- Instant download. This is a digital file; nothing is shipped.
- Bonus: our free one-page Ultimate Hiking Checklist

GOOD TO KNOW
Checked against nps.gov in October 2026. Roads, fees and rules change, so check nps.gov/yell and nps.gov/grte before your trip. For personal use.

Made by HikeSupply Co., a small shop for weekend hikers. More printable guides at hikesupplyco.com
